variant.title: Asterisk Sudoku
variant.description: The nine cells on the asterisk contain the digits 1 through 9 without repetition.
rule_guide.title: Asterisk Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: The nine cells joined by the asterisk lines must also contain the digits 1 through 9 without repetition.
